title: Thanking a Kind Stranger
paragraphs: Layla sedang naik bus pulang dari kerja ketika tasnya tiba-tiba terbuka. Semua dokumen dan kertasnya jatuh ke lantai bus yang penuh sesak. Ia merasa malu, tapi seorang asing yang duduk di dekatnya dengan cepat berlutut untuk membantunya.

Ia mengambil setiap kertas dengan hati-hati, satu per satu, lalu menyerahkannya kembali sesuai urutan. "Ini semuanya sudah lengkap," katanya sambil tersenyum tenang dan ramah. "Terima kasih banyak," kata Layla dengan tulus.

"Ini bukan apa-apa," jawab pria itu sebelum kembali ke tempat duduknya dan melanjutkan panggilan teleponnya. Layla merasa sangat berterima kasih atas kebaikannya di tengah hari yang melelahkan setelah shift kerja yang panjang.

Malam itu, Layla menceritakan momen kecil di bus itu kepada suaminya. Ia menyadari bahwa satu tindakan kebaikan singkat dari orang yang mungkin tidak akan pernah ia temui lagi tetap berhasil mengubah suasana seluruh malamnya.
answerKey: Layla is riding the bus home from work when her bag suddenly opens. All her documents and papers fall onto the floor of the crowded bus. She feels embarrassed, but a stranger sitting nearby quickly kneels down to help her. He picks up every paper carefully, one by one, and hands them back to her in order. "Here you are, all of them," he says with a calm and kind smile. "Thank you so much," Layla says sincerely. "It is truly nothing at all," the man replies before returning to his seat and continuing his phone call. Layla feels genuinely grateful for his kindness during an otherwise stressful and tiring day at the end of a long shift. That night, Layla tells her husband about the small moment on the bus. She realizes that a brief act of kindness from someone she will likely never see again still managed to change the tone of her whole evening.
